sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "interactions"."interactidolpivot" AS e, "virtualidols"."genretag" AS g, SUM("interactions"."gifttot") AS m1 FROM "interactions" JOIN "virtualidols" ON "virtualidols"."entityreg" = "interactions"."interactidolpivot"  GROUP BY "interactions"."interactidolpivot", "virtualidols"."genretag"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: total of gifts sent per virtualidols within virtualidols.genretag (additive)
share of the all total of total of gifts sent (all level)
rank within the group by total of gifts sent, keep the top 3

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "interactions"."interactfanpivot" AS e, "fans"."statustag" AS g, AVG("interactions"."gifttot") AS m1 FROM "interactions" JOIN "fans" ON "fans"."userregistry" = "interactions"."interactfanpivot"  GROUP BY "interactions"."interactfanpivot", "fans"."statustag"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: average of gifts sent per fans within fans.statustag
gap to the all average of average of gifts sent (all level)
rank within the group by average of gifts sent, keep the top 3

rank within the group by number of membershipandspending records: share of the g total, keep the top 3
